blocks.text: CEBU CITY —Bella Belen has shown she was born for the bright lights, and the Premier Volleyball League’s 10th anniversary celebration offers another chance for her to prove she is one of Philippine volleyball’s biggest stars. Belen and the Capital1 Solar Spikers test their offseason recruitment coup against the Choco Mucho Flying Titans in the PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Saturday at SM Seaside Cebu Arena. With the league selling out 18,000 seats for the opener, Belen is expected to rise to the occasion and put on a show after a stellar rookie season. “It’s really special because we were […]...
